purpose: Construct one exact-400 research-only protected development package without structurally parsing score/result fields before package identity is frozen.

selection_rule.competition_metadata: Parse data/competitions.json; it contains competition/season metadata only.
selection_rule.match_identity_extraction: For each eligible competition-season raw matches JSON, extract only literal match_id tokens with a byte regex. Do not json.loads the match payload and do not reference score/result fields.

excluded_competition_ids.2: EPL / World Model V0 and prior StatsBomb work
excluded_competition_ids.7: Ligue 1 / prior zero-label and metadata probes
excluded_competition_ids.9: Bundesliga / World Model V1 coverage probe
excluded_competition_ids.12: Serie A prior StatsBomb research domain
excluded_competition_ids.37: WSL / World Model V1 viewed panel
excluded_competition_ids.43: FIFA World Cup prior World Model source-pool probe
excluded_competition_ids.49: NWSL / World Model V2 metadata viewed panel
excluded_competition_ids.55: UEFA Euro current-session score exposure via Wyscout mirror
excluded_competition_ids.223: Copa America prior World Model source-pool probe

selection_rule.competition_choice: Among remaining competition_ids, select the numerically lowest competition_id whose summed identity-only match count across all listed seasons is at least 400.

forbidden_before_identity_freeze: json.loads or equivalent structured parsing of any per-season match payload
reading home_score, away_score, winner, result, score, label or event outcome fields
